prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, and whether you need SEO, PPC, content, social, creative, analytics, or a full-service partner.

Before I recommend specific firms, a few quick questions so I can give you a tailored shortlist:
- What are your primary goals? (brand awareness, lead gen, e‑commerce sales, app installs, etc.)
- Which services do you need? (SEO, paid search/social, creative, content, email, CRO, analytics, web/app dev)
- What’s your monthly budget range for agency fees/ad spend?
- Company stage and size (startup, SMB, enterprise)?
- Any industry focus or markets (B2B vs B2C, healthcare, fintech, SaaS, local)?
- Timeline (ongoing vs short campaign)?

If you want to evaluate agencies yourself, use these sources and criteria:
- Where to search: Clutch.co, G2, Agency Spotter, Google My Business, LinkedIn, referrals from peers.
- What to check: case studies with measurable outcomes, client list and tenure, industry experience, team bios, reporting cadence and KPIs, pricing model, communication process, contract terms, references/reviews.
- Red flags: vague promises (e.g., “#1 on Google”), no measurable results, unclear team or turnover, long lock-in without performance clauses.

Questions to ask shortlisted agencies:
- Which KPIs would you track for our goals and how often do you report?
- Show 1–2 case studies for clients like us (industry, size, results).
- Who will be on the account team and how much time will they dedicate to us?
- What tools/platforms do you use for analytics/PPC/SEO?
- How do you approach attribution and measuring ROI?
- What is onboarding like and expected timeline to see results?

If you want, I can:
- Recommend a short list of 4–6 San Francisco agencies matched to your answers above (with links, sample case studies, estimated pricing),
or
- Pull the current top-rated SF digital agencies from Clutch/G2 and summarize their strengths.

Which would you prefer?
